name: The Teacup Nebula Observatory
description: A whimsical observatory where telescopes are made from giant teacups and the cosmos appears as swirling tea leaves and steaming galaxy patterns.
prompt: A charming observatory perched on a hilltop where all the telescopes are oversized vintage teacups with floral patterns, steaming gently with cosmic vapors. Through each cup-telescope, viewers see the universe rendered as swirling tea leaves, cinnamon star clusters, and cream nebulae. The dome is covered in cookie constellation maps while the viewing platform is surrounded by candy cane railings. A friendly astronomer in a apron dotted with star charts serves hot cocoa to stargazers. Playful fantasy, warm cozy colors, detailed vintage aesthetic.
caption: Steeped in stardust and served with a side of wonder... ☕🌌
